prompt: With your grown-up, which is the safe way to investigate sunlight outdoors?

options.text: Observe a toy’s shadow on paper.
Use a magnifying glass to stare at the Sun.
Stand in the road to see better.

explanation: Observe the shadow on paper with your adult in a safe place. Never look directly at the Sun, and stay away from roads.

sources.title: NASA: I Tell Only Sunny Hours
